about: Panadeine Forte (paracetamol with codeine), by brand name only, is supplied on 18, 23 and 28 November 2025. Each 20-tablet pack covers five days at one tablet every six hours, forming one continuous 15-day course.
One supply of dextromethorphan (Robitussin Dry Cough Forte, a cough liquid) on 10 February 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
The two five-day codeine courses are months apart. The cough liquids contain bromhexine, guaifenesin or ribwort plantain.
